issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Farm to use a List implemented as an ArrayList and to initialize it in the no-argument constructor, but the solution implements the animals collection as a Set (HashSet). This type mismatch (List vs Set) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the intended collection type and ordering/duplication semantics expected by the exercise and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Farm class use a List<Animal> (for example, ArrayList<Animal>) for the animals attribute and initialize it in the no-argument constructor as described in the problem statement. Alternatively, if using a Set is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to specify a Set/HashSet so all artifacts agree.
